landing.title: Training planner and log for your dog
landing.heading: Plan and log your dog's training
landing.lead: Build a plan for each dog, schedule exercises across the week and write down how each session went. The history shows how your dog is improving.
landing.featuresLead: For handlers who train on their own or with a trainer.

plan.title: A plan for each dog
plan.description: Set up disciplines, goals and exercises the way you need them and change them whenever you like.

calendar.title: Weekly calendar
calendar.description: Exercises can repeat every week. Anything you don't get to, you move to another day.

log.title: Training log
log.description: Add a note to each exercise. It works on a phone right at the training field.

progress.title: Training history
progress.description: Your records stay in the history, so you can look back at them any time. When your dog masters a goal, you mark it as achieved.

landing.closingLead: Signing up is free. Once you're in, you can add your dog and set up a first plan right away.

welcome.title: Welcome to TrainLoop
welcome.body: In a few minutes we'll add a dog, pick a discipline and plan your first week of exercises.

menu.title: Open the menu
menu.body: The menu holds your dogs, calendar and disciplines. Tap it.

addDog.title: Add a dog
addDog.body: Click Add dog. A name is enough, the rest can wait.
addDog.bodyTouch: Tap Add dog. A name is enough, the rest can wait.

dogProfile.title: {{name}} is in
dogProfile.body: This is the dog's profile. You'll see disciplines, progress and ratings here.

assignDiscipline.title: Assign a discipline
assignDiscipline.body: Pick a ready-made discipline with goals and exercises by area, or create your own.

openCalendar.title: Discipline assigned
openCalendar.body: Now let's plan the first exercise. Open the Calendar.
openCalendar.bodyTouch: Now let's plan the first exercise. Open the menu and tap Calendar.

schedule.title: Plan an exercise
schedule.body: Choose a dog, exercise and time. The dog and discipline are already selected.

event.title: Exercises are planned
event.body: After training, click the exercise, rate it with stars and add a note or video if you like.

views.title: Day, week, month
views.body: Switch the calendar view here. Done, your first week is planned!

install.title: Add TrainLoop to your home screen
install.body: Then open it at training with one tap, right from your phone's home screen.

safari.share: At the bottom of Safari, tap Share (the square with an arrow).

chromeIos.share: In Chrome, tap Share (the square with an arrow) on the right of the address bar.

edgeIos.share: In Edge, tap ⋯ at the bottom and choose Share.

chromeAndroid.share: In Chrome, tap ⋮ at the top right.

edgeAndroid.share: In Edge, tap ⋯ at the bottom.

ownGoal.title: Add a goal and an exercise
ownGoal.body: Your own discipline is empty so far. Create its first goal with Add goal.

ownExercise.title: Add an exercise
ownExercise.body: The goal is ready. Add its first exercise so there's something to plan.

disciplineDialog.intro: Pick a ready-made discipline by area or create your own. You can edit its goals and exercises at any time.
disciplineDialog.customHint: Start with an empty discipline and add goals yourself.
